name: graft
description: A local verification governor that checks Codex checkpoints before a task stops.

interface.shortDescription: Verify Codex checkpoints with complementary local evidence
interface.longDescription: GRAFT observes Codex turns, freezes changed workspace state at completion checkpoints, selects a verifier subset under a configured budget, and either allows completion or returns reproducible evidence for another repair turn.
defaultPrompt: Show the GRAFT status for this workspace
Initialize safe GRAFT verifiers for this repository
Explain the latest GRAFT verification report
